verdict.rationale: Missive documents built-in AI that composes and replies to messages, and assistant-created drafts land as drafts you can review before sending. Nothing in the evidence shows the AI learning or matching the user's own voice, tone, or writing style, which is the defining part of this story. Missing for 10: documented voice/tone or style personalization (e.g., learning from sent mail or style settings), and any hands-on or independent corroboration that drafts avoid generic boilerplate.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI drafts replies in my own voice and tone — ready to review and send, not generic boilerplate

citations.quote: Quickly compose, reply, and translate messages with AI directly in Missive.
Drafts created outside the composer, by the assistant, by a rule, or through the API and MCP server, now resolve {{ user.name }} and {{ user.email }} from your organization profile
